message.content: Please make the pack build refuse a mixed set of vectors instead of publishing it.

content.text: I'll add a guard in Pack::build and a test for the mixed case.
Done: Pack::build now bails on a mixed pack, with a test that pins the message. We decided against sparse usearch support because cosine_for cannot handle a missing row.
